components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id

The build is green. Here's what I implemented for the telephone-normalization rule on create (`POST /api/owners`).

## Changes

**1. Relaxed the DTO schema so formatted input isn't pre-rejected** — `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`
The generated `OwnerFieldsDto` previously carried `pattern: '^[0-9]*$'` on `telephone`, so a value like `"(04) 1234-5678"` failed bean validation with a 400 *before* any normalization could run. I removed the digits-only pattern (and bumped `maxLength` to 30 to give formatted input room), keeping `minLength: 1` and the `required` constraint.

**2. New normalize step** — `NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java`
Strips every non-digit (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), requires exactly 10 digits, and writes the 10-digit value back onto the shared `OwnerFieldsDto` (`@Val` yields the stored instance, so `BuildOwner` maps the normalized value). Not-exactly-10 digits throws the checked `InvalidTelephoneException`.

**3. Error handling** — `InvalidTelephoneException` + `InvalidTelephoneExceptionHandler` + escalation YAML, responding 400 with the same `{"errors": ["telephone"]}` shape as the existing `MissingOwnerFieldsExceptionHandler`.

**4. Pipeline wiring** — `owners.POST.yml` now runs `validate → require → normalize → build → save → respond`, with `normalize` under the same `transaction` governance as its neighbours.

The stored/returned value is the 10 digits, consistent with the `Owner` entity's existing `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` constraint.

- `errorRejectsTooFewDigits`: `"12345"` → 400 ✅
- Full suite: `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**

One scope note: relaxing the OpenAPI pattern also removes the digits-only bean-validation on `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`, but the `Owner` entity's own `^[0-9]{10}$` pattern still guards persistence there, and no tests cover that path. The normalization itself is applied only on create, as the spec requires.
